title.en: I went, I saw, I took
title.de: Die Vergangenheit, unregelmäßig: I went, I saw
title.sl: Preteklik, nepravilni glagoli: I went, I saw
title.it: Il passato, verbi irregolari: I went, I saw

goal.sl: Poveš, kaj se je zgodilo, z nepravilnimi glagoli vsakdana (I went, I saw, I took, she made, they found), v eni obliki za vse osebe.
goal.de: Du erzählst, was passiert ist, mit den unregelmäßigen Verben des Alltags (I went, I saw, I took, she made, they found), in einer Form für alle Personen.
goal.it: Racconti che cosa è successo con i verbi irregolari di ogni giorno (I went, I saw, I took, she made, they found), in una sola forma per tutte le persone.
goal.en: You can tell what happened with the irregular verbs of daily life (I went, I saw, I took, she made, they found), one form for every person.

say.sl: Pogosti glagoli nimajo **-ed**: vsak ima svoj preteklik, isti za vse osebe. go → **went** (šel), come → **came** (prišel), see → **saw** (videl), take → **took** (vzel), get → **got** (dobil, vstal): **I went**, **she went**, **they went**. Nikoli *goed*, nikoli *comed*.
say.de: Häufige Verben haben kein **-ed**: Jedes hat seine eigene Vergangenheit, gleich für alle Personen. go → **went** (ging), come → **came** (kam), see → **saw** (sah), take → **took** (nahm), get → **got** (bekam, stand auf): **I went**, **she went**, **they went**. Nie *goed*, nie *comed*.
say.it: I verbi più comuni non hanno **-ed**: ognuno ha un passato suo, uguale per tutte le persone. go → **went** (sono andato), come → **came** (sono venuto), see → **saw** (ho visto), take → **took** (ho preso), get → **got** (ho ricevuto, mi sono alzato): **I went**, **she went**, **they went**. Mai *goed*, mai *comed*.
say.en: Common verbs have no **-ed**: each has a past of its own, the same for every person. go → **went** (never *goed*), come → **came** (never *comed*), see → **saw**, take → **took**, get → **got**: **I went**, **she went**, **they went**.

say.sl: Pri mizi in doma: make → **made** (naredil), have → **had** (imel), eat → **ate** (pojedel), drink → **drank** (spil), give → **gave** (dal). buy → **bought** (kupil) in bring → **brought** (prinesel) loči samo r. Nikoli *eated*, nikoli *buyed*.
say.de: Am Tisch und zu Hause: make → **made** (machte), have → **had** (hatte), eat → **ate** (aß), drink → **drank** (trank), give → **gave** (gab). buy → **bought** (kaufte) und bring → **brought** (brachte) trennt nur das r. Nie *eated*, nie *buyed*.
say.it: A tavola e in casa: make → **made** (ho fatto), have → **had** (ho avuto), eat → **ate** (ho mangiato), drink → **drank** (ho bevuto), give → **gave** (ho dato). buy → **bought** (ho comprato) e bring → **brought** (ho portato) si distinguono solo per la r. Mai *eated*, mai *buyed*.
say.en: At the table and at home: make → **made**, have → **had**, eat → **ate** (never *eated*), drink → **drank**, give → **gave**. buy → **bought** (never *buyed*) and bring → **brought** differ only by the r.

say.sl: Za besede in misli: say → **said** (rekel), tell → **told** (povedal), know → **knew** (vedel), think → **thought** (mislil), hear → **heard** (slišal), write → **wrote** (napisal). Po **told** pride oseba, po **said** ne: **He told us a story.** **He said hello.**
say.de: Für Worte und Gedanken: say → **said** (sagte), tell → **told** (erzählte), know → **knew** (wusste), think → **thought** (dachte), hear → **heard** (hörte), write → **wrote** (schrieb). Nach **told** kommt die Person, nach **said** nicht: **He told us a story.** **He said hello.**
say.it: Per parole e pensieri: say → **said** (ho detto), tell → **told** (ho raccontato), know → **knew** (sapevo), think → **thought** (ho pensato), hear → **heard** (ho sentito), write → **wrote** (ho scritto). Dopo **told** viene la persona, dopo **said** no: **He told us a story.** **He said hello.**
say.en: For words and thoughts: say → **said**, tell → **told**, know → **knew**, think → **thought**, hear → **heard**, write → **wrote**. **told** takes a person, **said** doesn't: **He told us a story.** **He said hello.**

say.sl: Za dan in pot: run → **ran** (tekel), sit → **sat** (sedel), sleep → **slept** (spal), meet → **met** (srečal), leave → **left** (odšel), lose → **lost** (izgubil), find → **found** (našel), pay → **paid** (plačal). Nikoli *runned*, nikoli *payed*.
say.de: Für den Tag und den Weg: run → **ran** (lief), sit → **sat** (saß), sleep → **slept** (schlief), meet → **met** (traf), leave → **left** (ging weg), lose → **lost** (verlor), find → **found** (fand), pay → **paid** (zahlte). Nie *runned*, nie *payed*.
say.it: Per la giornata e la strada: run → **ran** (ho corso), sit → **sat** (mi sono seduto), sleep → **slept** (ho dormito), meet → **met** (ho incontrato), leave → **left** (sono partito), lose → **lost** (ho perso), find → **found** (ho trovato), pay → **paid** (ho pagato). Mai *runned*, mai *payed*.
say.en: For the day and the road: run → **ran** (never *runned*), sit → **sat**, sleep → **slept**, meet → **met**, leave → **left**, lose → **lost**, find → **found**, pay → **paid** (never *payed*).

say.sl: Nekateri ostanejo enaki: put → **put** (dal), cut → **cut** (odrezal), shut → **shut** (zaprl). Preteklik pokažeta čas in to, da ni -s: **She put the key on the table yesterday.** read → **read** se piše enako, izgovoriš pa kot red: **I read the letter last night.**
say.de: Manche bleiben gleich: put → **put** (legte), cut → **cut** (schnitt), shut → **shut** (machte zu). Die Vergangenheit zeigen die Zeit und das fehlende -s: **She put the key on the table yesterday.** read → **read** schreibt man gleich, sagt es aber wie red: **I read the letter last night.**
say.it: Alcuni restano uguali: put → **put** (ho messo), cut → **cut** (ho tagliato), shut → **shut** (ho chiuso). Il passato si vede dal tempo e dalla -s che manca: **She put the key on the table yesterday.** read → **read** si scrive uguale, ma si pronuncia come red: **I read the letter last night.**
say.en: Some stay the same: put → **put**, cut → **cut**, shut → **shut**. The time and the missing -s show the past: **She put the key on the table yesterday.** read → **read** is spelled the same but said like red: **I read the letter last night.**

say.sl: V pripovedi stojijo ob glagolih na -ed: **Jack got up at five, walked up the fell and found the lamb.** (Jack je vstal ob petih, šel na hrib in našel jagnje.) Tudi po **and** je vsak glagol v pretekliku. Pazi: **got** je preteklik, **I've got** pa pomeni imam.
say.de: In einer Erzählung stehen sie neben den Verben auf -ed: **Jack got up at five, walked up the fell and found the lamb.** (Jack stand um fünf auf, ging auf den Berg und fand das Lamm.) Auch nach **and** steht jedes Verb in der Vergangenheit. Vorsicht: **got** ist Vergangenheit, **I've got** heißt ich habe.
say.it: In un racconto stanno accanto ai verbi in -ed: **Jack got up at five, walked up the fell and found the lamb.** (Jack si è alzato alle cinque, è salito sul monte e ha trovato l'agnello.) Anche dopo **and** ogni verbo è al passato. Attenzione: **got** è passato, **I've got** vuol dire ho.
say.en: In a story they stand beside the verbs in -ed: **Jack got up at five, walked up the fell and found the lamb.** After **and** too, every verb is in the past. Careful: **got** is the past, **I've got** means I have.

translation.sl: Včeraj je šel Jack z avtobusom v Keswick. S seboj je vzel Meg. Na tržnici je srečal gospo Birkett in skupaj sta spila skodelico čaja. Kupil je nov plašč in zanj plačal štirideset funtov. Potem je zagledal zadnji avtobus in stekel!
translation.de: Gestern ist Jack mit dem Bus nach Keswick gefahren. Er hat Meg mitgenommen. Auf dem Markt hat er Mrs Birkett getroffen, und sie haben eine Tasse Tee getrunken. Er hat einen neuen Mantel gekauft und vierzig Pfund dafür bezahlt. Dann hat er den letzten Bus gesehen und ist gerannt!
translation.it: Ieri Jack è andato a Keswick in autobus. Ha portato con sé Meg. Al mercato ha incontrato la signora Birkett e hanno preso una tazza di tè. Ha comprato un cappotto nuovo e l'ha pagato quaranta sterline. Poi ha visto l'ultimo autobus e si è messo a correre!
translation.en: Yesterday Jack went to Keswick on the bus. He took Meg with him. At the market he met Mrs Birkett, and they had a cup of tea. He bought a new coat and paid forty pounds for it. Then he saw the last bus and ran!

translation.sl: Pred dvema dnevoma je Arthur na hribu izgubil klobuk. Mislil je, da je pri panjih, pa ni bil. Potem ga je Poppy našla ob potoku in mu ga vrnila. Rekel je hvala in ji dal kozarec medu.
translation.de: Vor zwei Tagen hat Arthur seinen Hut am Berg verloren. Er hat gedacht, er ist bei den Bienenstöcken, aber dort war er nicht. Dann hat Poppy ihn beim Bach gefunden und ihm zurückgegeben. Er hat Danke gesagt und ihr ein Glas Honig gegeben.
translation.it: Due giorni fa Arthur ha perso il cappello sul monte. Pensava che fosse vicino agli alveari, ma non c'era. Poi Poppy l'ha trovato vicino al ruscello e glielo ha ridato. Lui ha detto grazie e le ha dato un vasetto di miele.
translation.en: Two days ago Arthur lost his hat on the fell. He thought it was by the hives, but it wasn't. Then Poppy found it by the beck and gave it back to him. He said thank you and gave her a jar of honey.
